exposure: fetal position at onset of labor
Fetal occiput position at onset of labor
cohort: 1250 nulliparous women with singleton pregnancies and live fetuses without structural anomalies at term gestation who underwent transabdominal ultrasound scan to determine fetal occiput position at the onset of labor
finding: There is no evidence of an association between fetal LOA position at onset of labor and SVD, challenging the theory that LOA is the optimum fetal position for spontaneous vaginal birth.
mod_finding: This study found no association between fetal left occipito-anterior position at the onset of labor and the likelihood of spontaneous vaginal delivery.
